test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ______ became India's first sports unicorn with its market cap having touched a high of Rs. 7,600 crores as of 30 January 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai Super Kings.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chennai Super Kings (CSK) **is a cricket franchise that participates in the **Indian Premier League (IPL).**
 
• As of **30 January 2022**, CSK became **India's first sports unicorn** with a market capitalization of** Rs. 7,600 crores.**
 
• A unicorn is a term used for a startup or a company that has a** valuation of over $1 billion**.
 
• CSK has been one of the **most successful teams **in the IPL, having won the tournament five times and reaching the finals eight times.
 
• The team is owned by** India Cements,** a company that is headed by former** BCCI president N. Srinivasan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delhi Capitals:**

 
 
• Delhi Capitals (formerly Delhi Daredevils) is also a **cricket franchise** that participates in the IPL.
 
• The team is co-owned by the** GMR Group and the JSW Group.**
 
 
 
• **Kolkata Knight Riders:**
 
 
• Kolkata Knight Riders is another **cricket franchise** that participates in the IPL.
 
• The team is owned by Bollywood actor** Shah Rukh Khan, actress Juhi Chawla, and her spouse Jay Mehta. **
 
 
 
• **Mumbai Indians:**
 
 
• Mumbai Indians is a **cricket franchise** that participates in the IPL.
 
• The team is owned by India's biggest conglomerate**, Reliance Industries,** and is captained by Hardik Pandya.
